problem: The retired /analysis-requests compatibility endpoint authenticated callers but ignored a supplied projectId/project_id scope.
root_cause: Compatibility stub was called after authentication without applying the existing project access boundary.

change.behavior: When a project scope is supplied, require_project_access(read) runs before the non-executing stub; unscoped legacy calls remain accepted.

new_findings: CO-029 remains open for broader cross-project/cross-user route fuzzing.
